chart-shell-view.description: Card wrapper with hero KPI, view switcher, period filter, states, and legend composing every chart type.

examples.note: Switch views, change the period, toggle legend series, and open the actions menu. Every interaction lands in the log below.
examples.title: Weekly agent activity
examples.lineNote: Dots are keyboard-focusable: Tab to a dot, use the arrow keys to move, Enter to select.

views.note: The shell projects any chart into the same card. Use the tabs to switch the projected view; legend, hero, and period keep working.
views.label: Chart view

display.note: Timeline renders the projected chart; list renders a totals table from the same series. The legend keeps toggling series in both modes.
display.label: Display mode

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone chart shell component.

props.note: The shell owns view and period models and emits toggles, actions, and retry. It never fetches and never mutates the series array.

states.note: Loading shows skeletons, errors show a retry action, and empty data shows guidance text. Use the tabs to switch states; retry lands in the log below.
states.label: Shell state

chart-shell-view.title: Chart Shell
